title: "My orders" page takes 4+ seconds for business customers since 2.4.0
author: sre-tomas
body:
`GET /customers/{id}/orders` p95 went from about 40 ms to 4.2 s after release 2.4.0 (2026-10-06).

It is worst for customers with many orders, for example customer #42. Nothing about this endpoint was changed in 2.4.0 as far as we know. The slow-query log has plenty of entries and I saved two execution plans from production (before and after the release).

Find the cause and recommend a fix that is safe to apply on a 1.2 million row table during business hours.
